head: GROTESK
dzh: 圆、拱、三角拼成的剪纸插画，纯色叠层
den: Paper-cut illustrations of circles, arches and triangles in flat layers
nzh: 用圆、半圆、三角、拱形拼插画，像剪纸一层叠一层；每层纯色，下层露一条深色边当阴影，不用渐变；4–5 个饱和色，留大块米白底；粗黑体标题，可以压在色块上
nen: Build illustrations from circles, half-circles, triangles and arches, layered like cut paper; flat colors only, each layer shows a darker edge below as its shadow, no gradients; 4-5 saturated colors on plenty of cream; heavy grotesk headings that may sit on the shapes
